acceptance_scope: Eligibility does not replace the untouched frozen three-mode run-case gates. Qualified failures remain failures.
capability_scope: Sibling probes observe native/effective capability. Actual workers are bound externally; no injected worker capability call.
claim_scope: A predeclared verifiable contract derived from one observed historical-success environment, not a causal model or a guarantee of new-host/all-mode success.

failure_classes.host_ineligible: Well-formed authentic preflight observations do not match the fixed host/runtime contract.
failure_classes.integrity_error: Profile/source/input authenticity, hash or schema error: hard failure, never host ineligibility.
failure_classes.qualification_observation_failure: A worker lacks required core mapping/process/environment evidence or exposes unpinned mapped files.
failure_classes.scientific_failure: An admitted original scientific gate fails; preserve it and reject overall acceptance.

contract.scope: Each actual scientific worker; not the run-case controller.
contract.transient_cache: On-disk identity is mandatory; observing the transient mapping is optional. If observed, mapped bytes must match.
contract.unobserved_optional_paths: Record coverage; pinned auxiliary modules may be unused.

microcode_scope: 0xffffffff is the virtual CPU-reported string, not an identified physical microcode revision.
